ayahs.ar: هَلْ اَتٰي عَلَي الْاِنْسَانِ حِيْنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُوْرًا ۝١
ayahs.tr: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجٍࣗۖ نَّبْتَلِيْهِ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ سَمِيْعًاۢ بَصِيْرًا ۝٢
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا هَدَيْنٰهُ السَّبِيْلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوْرًا ۝٣
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَاَغْلٰلًا وَّسَعِيْرًا ۝٤
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُوْنَ مِنْ كَاْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوْرًا ۝٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

ayahs.ar: عَيْنًا يَّشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوْنَهَا تَفْجِيْرًا ۝٦
ayahs.tr: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

ayahs.ar: يُوْفُوْنَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُوْنَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسْتَطِيْرًا ۝٧
ayahs.tr: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

ayahs.ar: وَيُطْعِمُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰي حُبِّهٖ مِسْكِيْنًا وَّيَتِيْمًا وَّاَسِيْرًا ۝٨
ayahs.tr: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيْدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَا࢜ءً وَّلَا شُكُوْرًا ۝٩
ayahs.tr: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوْسًا قَمْطَرِيْرًا ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

ayahs.ar: فَوَقٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقّٰىهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَّسُرُوْرًا ۝١١ۚ
ayahs.tr: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

ayahs.ar: وَجَزٰىهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيْرًا ۝١٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

ayahs.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا عَلَي الْاَرَا࢜ىِٕكِۚ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيْهَا شَمْسًا وَّلَا زَمْهَرِيْرًا ۝١٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

ayahs.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِيْلًا ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

ayahs.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيْرَا۟ؔ ۝١٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

ayahs.ar: قَوَارِيْرَا۟ؔ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوْهَا تَقْدِيْرًا ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

ayahs.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيْهَا كَاْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِيْلًا ۝١٧ۚ
ayahs.tr: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

ayahs.ar: عَيْنًا فِيْهَا تُسَمّٰي سَلْسَبِيْلًا ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

ayahs.ar: وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوْنَۚ اِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُو͏ٔ͏ْلُو͏ٔ͏ًا مَّنْثُوْرًا ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيْتَ نَعِيْمًا وَّمُلْكًا كَبِيْرًا ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

ayahs.ar: عٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٌؗ وَّحُلُّوْٓا اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍۚ وَسَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُوْرًا ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَا࢜ءً وَّكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا ۝٢٢ࣖ
ayahs.tr: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَنْزِيْلًا ۝٢٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

ayahs.ar: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ اٰثِمًا اَوْ كَفُوْرًا ۝٢٤ۚ
ayahs.tr: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

ayahs.ar: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًا ۝٢٥ۖۚ
ayahs.tr: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيْلًا ۝٢٦
ayahs.tr: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ يُحِبُّوْنَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوْنَ وَرَا࢜ءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيْلًا ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

ayahs.ar: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا͏ٓ اَسْرَهُمْۚ وَاِذَا شِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا بَدَّلْنَا͏ٓ اَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيْلًا ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا ۝٣٠ࣗۖ
ayahs.tr: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

ayahs.ar: يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمِيْنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا ۝٣١ࣖ
ayahs.tr: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
